# Particle Trails datapack
This datapack adds cool particle trails!
## Features
- Adds a variety of cool trails when standing on a certain block!
- Adds a nice creative spark to your world! ⚡👌 
## Blocks
This is a list of blocks to which I added trails.
- Stone
- Grass
- Crimson Nylium
- Warped Nylium
- Dirt
- Mud
- Mycelium
- Podzol
- Obsidian
- Cherry Leaves

## Notes
- This datapack can be safely added to an existing world without concerns!
- This datapack doesn't look too good ngl.
